verdict.rationale: Committing and pushing is a fair question for a GitHub client app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only reviewing, merging, code search and delegating work to Copilot agents (which open PRs on the user's behalf), not the user committing and pushing changes from the device. Those agent and merge features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit, and a community user notes the app 'doesn't really seem to be a git client'.
